plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in a debate with a well known skeptic, brings up Nuno Loureiro, a scientist he calls a leader in magnetic reconnection, a process in charged gas that Michels says is key to making nuclear fusion power work. Michels says Loureiro was shot dead at his own front door in 2025 and objects to treating it as a non-story, mentioning another scientist, Carl Grillmair, in the same breath. He raises it because some people suggest the deaths of scientists in sensitive fields may be connected.
